class.name: FellowBuoyancy3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a RigidBody3D floating on FellowWater3D's waves — Archimedes' buoyancy on points filling its shapes, drag towards the water's motion.
class.description: A child of a [RigidBody3D] that floats it on a [FellowWater3D]'s waves. The body's [CollisionShape3D] children are filled with points on a grid of [member point_spacing] (coarser until there are no more than [member max_points]), each the share of its shape's volume (boxes, spheres, capsules, cylinders and convex shapes exactly; other shapes as their bounding boxes). Every physics tick each point under the surface — the waves as drawn, from [method FellowWater3D.get_surface_height] — is pushed up by the weight of the water it displaces ([member water_density] x gravity x its volume under the surface) and dragged towards the water's own motion ([member linear_drag], the waves' orbital velocity with [member follow_waves]), at its place on the body; the body's turning is slowed by [member angular_drag] in the share of it under water. The body floats at its density's draft, rights itself or capsizes as its shape makes it, and rides the waves. Without a [member water_path], the [FellowWater3D] whose extent holds the body. On FellowEngine's buoyancy course (Jolt, 60 Hz): at rest in still water the displaced volume is the body's mass over the water's density within 0.01 % (boxes, a sphere, a barrel, a capsule, a convex wedge); a tilted raft rights itself, a post lies down and a cube of half the water's density floats edge up (45°), as the theory of floating bodies has them; in a 2.3 m sea a buoy's height follows the surface's under it (correlation 0.997) and twenty crates stay on it. 4 µs a body a tick (16-64 points); a body above [method FellowWater3D.get_surface_ceiling] costs 0.2 µs. Points crossing the surface make foam ([method FellowWater3D.add_foam], [member foam]): striking the water faster than 1 m/s, a splash round them (more the faster, up to fully covered at 5 m/s); at the waterline moving through the water faster than 0.4 m/s, a wake. [signal water_entered] and [signal water_exited] tell a game when to play a splash's sound or particles. [FellowDestructible3D]'s debris gets a [FellowBuoyancy3D] while the scene has water ([member FellowDestructible3D.debris_floats]).

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: The points the body's shapes are filled with.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: [code]points[/code], [code]volume[/code] (m³), [code]ticks[/code], [code]usec_per_tick[/code] (the mean CPU time a physics tick), [code]skipped_ticks[/code] (the body above the waves' reach), [code]bound_radius[/code] (metres: the points' cells within it of the body's origin), [code]submerged_share[/code].

method.name: get_submerged_share
method.description: The share of the body's volume under the surface at the last physics tick ([code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]).

method.name: get_volume
method.description: The body's volume (its shapes'), in cubic metres.

method.name: is_in_water
method.description: [code]true[/code] if any of the body was under the surface at the last physics tick.

method.name: rebuild_points
method.description: Fills the body's shapes with points again at the next physics tick (after its shapes changed).

members.member: How fast the water slows the body's turning, in 1/s when it is all under water (in proportion to the share of it that is).
How much foam the body makes on the water (splashes, its wake), as a factor; [code]0.0[/code]: none.
If [code]true[/code], the drag is against the body's motion relative to the water's (the waves' orbital velocity); if [code]false[/code], relative to still water.

How fast the water slows the body's points towards its own motion, in 1/s when they are under water (each as its share of the body's mass). Measured: a box dropped in settles in 5-7 s with 3.0 (in 13-17 s with 1.0).
The most points the shapes are filled with ([member point_spacing] made coarser until they fit).
The spacing of the points filling the shapes, in metres.

How loud the body is in the water ([member FellowWater3D.sound_enabled]), as a factor; [code]0.0[/code]: silent. A body out of the water striking it faster than 1 m/s plays a splash ([method FellowWater3D.play_splash]: its striking points' footprint, their speed); the water closing over points of a body in it faster than 0.15 m/s (a wave, its bobbing, it going deeper) a lap, softer; its waterline moving through the water a wake ([method FellowWater3D.add_wake_sound]).
The water's density, in kg/m³ (sea water: 1025). The body floats if its mass over its volume is less.
The [FellowWater3D] to float on. Empty: the one whose extent holds the body.

signal.name: water_entered
signal.description: Emitted at the physics tick a body out of the water gets a part of it under the surface. [param speed]: the fastest of its points going in, relative to the water, in m/s.

signal.name: water_exited
signal.description: Emitted at the physics tick a body in the water has none of it under the surface any more.
